name: yamnet-drone-detector
description: Standalone YAMNet + dense classifier for drone audio detection.

binary.eval_split: clip-level GroupShuffleSplit (all ~1s windows of a source clip kept on one side; no window-level leakage)
binary.note: Trained on ERAU+extra plus field data (QST detections, QST night negatives, USAFA DFEC) AND 5,000 Kilo-verified false-positive HARD NEGATIVES harvested from 8h of live Shaw audio (2026-06-04): clips where Angels Envy fired (peak>=0.7) but the independent Kilo Lani detector cleared on native audio (<0.35). 47% of the live Shaw stream was such false positives (vehicle/water/wind broadband confounders the night-negatives never covered). Adding them cut the held-out false-positive rate on unseen confounder clips from 0.305 -> 0.011 @0.7 (eval_falsepos_ab.py / retrain_with_harvest.py), generalized to a fully held-out sensor (SH006 FP 0.102 -> 0.043), and did NOT harm clean-domain negatives (0.048 -> 0.024). default_threshold lowered 0.7 -> 0.45: the hard-negative model dominates the precision/recall frontier, so at ~0.45 it keeps field-drone recall ~0.73-0.78 while holding verified-neg FP ~0.025-0.035 (threshold_sweep.py). NOTE: this 0.45 applies to DroneDetector.detect (mean-pooled clip score); the live phone/bridge worker fires on peak_score (per-frame max) and its threshold should be re-tuned on peak semantics. Also fixed a validation_split footgun in train.py/eval_field_ab.py (Keras took the unshuffled last 10% as validation; appended buckets landed entirely in val and corrupted early stopping).

subtype.eval_split: stratified (subtype excludes the windowed field-drone buckets, so no leakage to correct)
subtype.note: Label set unchanged: the new field drone types (Falcon 450, Teal 2, Fortem DroneHunter) have too few clips to form subtype classes, so they are binary positives only (SUBTYPE_EXCLUDED_LABELS). Small shift vs prior is run-to-run init noise.

input_format.note: DroneDetector resamples and downmixes automatically; external pipelines may pass any sample rate / channel layout.

datasets.title: YAMNet Embeddings for Drone Detection
datasets.role: Base: matrice / mavic3 / mavicmini drone subtypes + no_drone negatives

datasets.title: DroneAudioDataset
datasets.license: No explicit license; cite IWCMC 2019 paper
datasets.role: Adds bebop and mambo drone subtypes + ESC-50/speech-noise negatives

datasets.title: Multiclass Acoustic Dataset visualization samples
datasets.role: 32 single-clip drone-model samples used as binary positives only

datasets.title: DroneAudioSet (Augmented Human Lab / Bosch, 2025)
datasets.role: 5,040 1-sec rotor-noise positives chunked from the drone-only/ subset. SAR dataset (no drone-type labels); fed to the binary head only via SUBTYPE_EXCLUDED_LABELS.

datasets.title: ESC-50 exterior-sound confounders (classes 40-49)
datasets.role: 400 targeted false-positive confounders: helicopter, chainsaw, siren, car_horn, engine, train, church_bells, airplane, fireworks, hand_saw (40 each). Drives the binary precision improvement.

datasets.title: QST sensor detections (Argos field deployment)
datasets.role: Binary field data from the deployed SH003-SH016 sensors (Sumter SC, 2026-04), 8 kHz-origin. Positives: 87 drone-detection clips -> 2,959 ~1s windows (no model subtype). Negatives: 24 dead-of-night (01:00 local / 05:00 UTC) windows -> 4,310 no_drone windows, pulled via pull_negative_audio.py to rebalance and to provide held-out field negatives for false-alarm measurement. Real-world deployment distribution.

datasets.title: USAF Academy DFEC drone-audio set
datasets.publisher: USAF Academy DFEC (delivered via DOD SAFE, 2026-02-13)
datasets.role: 11 recordings: Falcon 450 / Teal 2 / Fortem DroneHunter (70 windows, binary positives only) + box-fan and tow-plane hard-negatives (40 windows, no_drone).
